compatibility_changes: Three NumPy stack generator arguments materialized as lists; numerical expressions unchanged.
reference_limitations: Default source scales neuron counts and synapses; full scale requires separate resource and scientific qualification.
Artificial-cell integration uses Euler updates triggered by a background clock.
Current-pulse controls extend source Iext; they are not arbitrary-neuron optogenetic controls.
Refractory synaptic current is frozen and refractory inputs are ignored; reducing the clock step cannot restore standard exponential-PSC LIF semantics.
